description:
Kwon Hyun-Seo, top student in the school, well-liked by peers, trusted by teachers. He has a father who frequently resorts to violence and a troublesome younger brother. One day, while enduring life solely for the thought of escaping home, he hears news that his brother has been bullied at school. The perpetrator is Lee Si-Hyun, a classmate of his younger brother. Enraged by the perpetrator's attitude, showing no sign of remorse and trying to settle it with money, he ultimately lets it go, powerless. After that, his future becomes uncertain when he coincidentally encounters Lee Si-Hyun again and gets entangled with him...

 *“Since my life's already a sewer, come to me.”*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
